methodology.build: Release; Core-only console host with a copied assembly reference
methodology.warmup: Three 100 ms searches per position before measurement in each process
methodology.pairing: Five rounds, alternating before/after first, one sample per workload per process
methodology.fixedDepth: Opening depth 3, middle/late depth 2, 120-second safety budget
methodology.measurement: External Stopwatch around Search; current-thread allocated bytes; PV legality checked by replay after measurement
methodology.environment: Public game host and unrelated desktop workloads remained running; no affinity or clock control
methodology.invariants: All 30 fixed-depth searches return the same action and value as baseline within 1e-12; all 120 measured principal variations replay legally
methodology.nodeInterpretation: Pruning changes the searched tree. Fixed-depth latency and equal result are primary; equal-budget node counts alone are not comparable strength measures.

samplingProfile.command: dotnet-trace collect --profile dotnet-sampled-thread-time,dotnet-common --format Speedscope --output search.nettrace -- dotnet Harness.dll profile
samplingProfile.limitation: Sampled thread wall time was dominated by GC safepoint PollGC frames and long finalizer intervals. These samples are not reported as CPU cost percentages; direct isolated-operation timings guided prioritization.

reproduction.samplingCommand: The sampling trace used the original local harness profile mode; timing reproduction is supplied by the repository harness.

validation.source: Full isolated test run reported by the coordinating agent.
